notes: Stories created for tool routing, validation, and integration based on existing tool_router implementation.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for tool routing inputs and outputs
Added validation and error handling story
Added unit and integration tests story

SHARED-B-M1-S1.title: Define Tool Routing Schema and Validation Contract
SHARED-B-M1-S1.description: Define Pydantic models for all tool inputs and outputs, including strict validation rules, required fields, and error handling structure for invalid tool_use payloads.

SHARED-B-M1-S2.title: Implement Allowlist-Based Tool Routing Logic
SHARED-B-M1-S2.description: Implement core routing logic that dispatches tool calls only if present in an explicit allowlist, including mapping tool names to handlers and injecting chat history into execution context.

SHARED-B-M1-S3.title: Integrate Tool Router with FastAPI Agent Loop
SHARED-B-M1-S3.description: Integrate tool routing into the FastAPI main agent loop, ensuring Anthropic tool_use blocks are correctly parsed, routed, and responses returned to the conversation pipeline.

SHARED-B-M1-S4.title: Implement Validation and Error Handling for Tool Execution
SHARED-B-M1-S4.description: Add robust validation handling for malformed inputs, disallowed tools, and schema violations, returning safe, structured error responses without breaking the chat loop.

SHARED-B-M1-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Routing and Validation
SHARED-B-M1-S5.description: Create unit and integration tests to verify allowlist enforcement, schema validation, error handling, and correct routing behavior across supported tools.

SHARED-B-M1.mitigation: Strict allowlist enforcement and existing test coverage for tool_router
